change: Existing drained register cold reset value 0->1; no new state/ports/latency
cold_reset_authority: All producer/VM/return copies fenced before rst_n; this is not local-reset drain proof
nonfield_context: No admitted capture phase creates no capture debt; empty after authoritative cold reset is drained
field_context: drained is capture-debt state, not new-command completion: original command completion and expected field admission/association remain required
warm_reset: reset_request masks drained/idle/offers and latches sticky fault without clearing active/counters/records
admission: Accepted phase clears drained; only actual matched quota received/VM commits and empty records restore drained
C8_retire_guard: Original saved context completion/visibility fences AND capture_drained AND !capture_fault; field-demand command must actually admit its associated phase
